Best Flare Nut Wrenches

A flare nut wrench is a box end with a slot, so it slides over a brake, fuel, or power steering line and grips five of the six flats instead of two. Use an ordinary open-end wrench on a tube nut and the jaw spreads and rounds it. From a $20 metric set to the $137 flex head set you keep forever, here is what actually holds a rusted fitting.
